title: Plane Mirrors and Their Images
summary: Where the image is, why left and right swap, and how periscopes and kaleidoscopes use mirrors.

ib.note: Ray diagrams for plane mirrors are formalised in MYP 4

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 11: Light: Shadows and Reflections

objectives: I can describe the image in a plane mirror: virtual, upright, same size, as far behind as the object is in front.
I can explain how a periscope uses two mirrors at 45°.
misconceptions: The image is on the surface of the mirror.
A mirror swaps top and bottom.
You can catch a mirror image on a screen.
